positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: • Worked on contracts with multiple departments of Lennar, creating software for internal teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Communication · Architecture · TypeScript

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer (Contract)
positions.description:
• Developed an internal web application using React and NestJS to aggregate and standardize data from a wide range of sources, allowing finance employees to simulate and project land prices 5 years into the future, with data broken down to a month by month basis.
• Built custom APIs connected to internal SQL database storage using Prisma and NestJS, and hosted using Azure, allowing for data to be prepared for the front end application.
• Significantly improved productivity by creating functionality that allowed users to prepare data via an interactive menu instead of joining many different spreadsheets, and also enabled the users to view, edit, and collaborate on said data efficiently, rather than aggregating the data manually.
• Implemented user level authentication integrated with company accounts on Okta to increase the security of the app, safeguarding all backend calls with this authentication, protecting all endpoints.
• Integrated PowerBI services into webpages by consuming PowerBI APIs, allowing for data and tables presented to be accurate and up to date.
• Collaborated with other teams in order to ensure smooth integration of created materials into web application interface.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Communication · Architecture · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented automated accounting processes, such as managing payment and refund balancing, facilitating data transfer between endpoints, database management, and creating and maintaining file level data from separate batch data.
• Led design and development on projects dealing with the title order process, benefiting the financial portion of Lennar, a Fortune 500 company and second largest homebuilder in the US.
• Responsible for gathering business stakeholder needs, collaborating with multiple different departments to ensure that the expected value could be accounted for in project design.

positions.title: Learning Assistant - Structured Computer Organization
positions.description:
●	Assists Professor in facilitating smooth learning experience for the class.
●	Answers questions pertaining to the course subject matter.
●	Holds office hours outside of class to meet with further assist students one on one.

positions.title: Researcher - Research Experience for Undergraduates
positions.description:
● Worked as a researcher for the NSF Funded Research Experience for Undergraduates (REU) program at the School of Computing and Information Sciences at FIU. The focus of research was on Advanced Secured Sensor Enabling Technologies (ASSET).
● Participated in research for developing a lightweight networking platform for mobile Internet of Things (IoT) devices.
● This work is being continued beyond the completion of the NSF REU program.

●	Trained new associates in proper protocol.
